title: National emergency hotline 911
text: The number to call in an emergency is 911. For any emergency anywhere in the Philippines (police, fire, medical, rescue), call 911. It is the national emergency hotline, free and open 24 hours. It replaced the PNP Patrol 117 line, and since September 2025 the DILG's unified 911 also takes the place of many local emergency numbers.

title: Philippine Red Cross national hotline
text: Philippine Red Cross: call 143, or (02) 8790-2300. National Blood Center: (02) 8527-0000 or (02) 8527-8385 to 95.
source: Philippine Red Cross; PH Emergency Hotlines (e.gov.ph)

PNP (police): call 911 for emergencies; PNP lines (02) 8722-0650 and text hotline 0917-847-5757. Bureau of Fire Protection (national): (02) 8426-0219, (02) 8426-0246. PAGASA weather: (02) 8284-0800.

title: Other towns and barangays
text: For other municipalities in the map area (for example Tanauan, Santo Tomas, Bauan, San Pascual, Ibaan, Rosario, San Jose, Cuenca, Mabini, Taal, Malvar and Tingloy), this device has no verified hotline list yet. Call 911, the Batangas PDRRMO, or your municipal hall. Your barangay hall and its Barangay DRRM Committee are usually the first responders for evacuation. Facility records on the map sometimes include a phone number from OpenStreetMap; treat those as unverified.
